meta.author:
讚美之泉
詞 / 曲：鄭耀華 Frank Cheng

lines.a: 我並不完美 也並不特別
lines.b: I'm not perfect, I'm not special

lines.a: 而祢卻是為我捨棄生命的主
lines.b: But You are the God who gave Your life for me

lines.a: 我時常軟弱 有時會迷惑
lines.b: I am often weak, and sometimes I have doubts

lines.a: 但祢是道路真理和生命
lines.b: But You are the way, the truth, and the life

lines.a: 主祢要往哪裡走 我就跟祢走
lines.b: Lord, wherever You go, I will follow You

lines.a: 領我走到世界盡頭 一生不再回頭
lines.b: Lead me to the ends of the earth, never turning back

lines.a: 讓世界聽到我們敬拜 我們的禱告
lines.b: Let the world hear our worship and our prayers

lines.a: 讓復興從我們開始 將主愛帶到人群中
lines.b: Let revival start with us, bringing Your love to the crowds

lines.a: 縱然有許多的問題 我也不放棄
lines.b: Though there may be many troubles, I will not give up

lines.a: 祢大能賜給我勇氣 我會勇敢走出去
lines.b: Your great power gives me courage, and I will step out with boldness
